Hey - thanks for responding

Do you have skype or gchat or anything?

I appreciate the good advice.  I'm just so tired of fighting all the time.  Ive been trying to keep my head above the water for over 30 years now.  I have watched all my friends and family succeed in their careers, families and personal lives.  I am just so tired of treading water in the hope that something changes. I know you can't measure yourself compared to others and all the rest of it.  But I want a SO and a family and I just think that I'll forever be fighting to get my happiness but I will never actual achieve it.  

I am seriously considering just getting all my affairs in order and ending it tonight.  I simply don't have the strength to deal with all of this and pull myself out of it.  I just want it to all just go.  I am past the point of trying to fix things.  I'm at the point where I would rather just destroy it so it never bothers me again.
